name: GCS Bucket
description: Create, delete, or idempotently ensure a GCS bucket exists, as a materializable Dagster asset -- the Airflow GCSCreateBucketOperator/GCSDeleteBucketOperator equivalent.
author: Dagster Community

outputs.description: MaterializeResult with bucket name, action, and existed/created status in metadata

bucket_name.description: GCS bucket name (globally unique across all of GCS).
bucket_name.label: Bucket Name

action.description: 'ensure_exists' (default): create the bucket if missing; a no-op if it already exists and is owned by the caller (idempotent). 'create': expects the bucket NOT to already exist; fails loudly (409 Conflict) if it does. 'delete': idempotent -- deleting an already-absent bucket succeeds.
action.label: Action

location.description: GCS bucket location -- a region (e.g. 'us-central1') or multi-region (e.g. 'US', 'EU'). Ignored for action='delete'.
location.label: Location

storage_class.description: Default storage class for objects written to the bucket. Ignored for action='delete'.
storage_class.label: Storage Class

credentials_env_var.description: Env var holding a path to a GCP service account JSON key file. Unset uses application-default credentials (same convention as gcs_to_database_asset's credentials_env_var).
credentials_env_var.label: Credentials Env Var

force_delete.description: action='delete' only. GCS refuses to delete a non-empty bucket by default (safety). Set True to first delete every object in the bucket, then the bucket itself -- destructive and irreversible. Not recommended by Google for buckets with more than ~256 objects.
force_delete.label: Force Delete

deps.description: Upstream Dagster asset keys for lineage.
deps.label: Deps

owners.description: Asset owners -- team names ('team:analytics') or email addresses.
owners.label: Owners

asset_tags.description: Additional key-value tags applied to the asset in the Dagster catalog.
asset_tags.label: Asset Tags

kinds.description: Asset kinds for the catalog. Auto-includes 'gcp' and 'gcs' if empty.
kinds.label: Kinds

retry_policy_max_retries.description: Max retries on asset failure. Defines a RetryPolicy.
retry_policy_max_retries.label: Retry Policy Max Retries
